title: Only 12% Of Adults Can Pass This Nun Entrance Exam
summary: Explore Vows and Formation, Prayer and Purpose, Traditions and Communities, Commitment and Daily Life, A Life of Service across five six-question rounds.

landing.intro:
Explore prayer and purpose.
Discover what you know.

about.body:
Five rounds offer different angles on this challenge: Vows and Formation, Prayer and Purpose, Traditions and Communities, Commitment and Daily Life, A Life of Service. Each round contains six distinct questions.

Choose one of four answers and move on automatically. There is no time limit. A short rewarded ad opens the quiz, each next round and the final result. The target is 24 correct answers out of 30. The result describes this quiz attempt only.

For entertainment and general learning only. This is not a vocational assessment, formation process or statement of eligibility. Practices vary across religious institutes, churches and traditions.

steps: Press Start, watch a short rewarded ad and begin.
Choose one answer per question and progress through five rounds.
Complete all 30 questions to reveal your result. You can then unlock the full breakdown.

nun-q1.question: Which three commitments are commonly called the evangelical counsels?

answers.a1: Poverty, chastity and obedience

nun-q2.question: What is the formal period of preparation before first profession commonly called?

answers.a1: A conclave

nun-round1-new1.question: What does discernment mean in a religious vocation?

answers.a1: Reflecting carefully on a possible calling
answers.a2: Automatically taking lifelong vows at first interest

nun-round1-new2.question: What is a postulancy commonly associated with?

answers.a1: An initial period of exploring life in a community

nun-round1-new3.question: What does community life usually involve?

answers.a1: Shared responsibilities as well as prayer

nun-round1-new4.question: Why should the practices of a particular institute be checked directly?

answers.a1: Formation and daily customs can differ
answers.a3: Every title has one universal informal meaning
answers.a4: A fictional film is always authoritative

nun-q3.question: What word often describes the distinctive spiritual gift and mission of a religious institute?

answers.a1: Canon

nun-q4.question: What is the Church’s cycle of prayer at set times of day called?

answers.a1: The lectionary
The head of certain women's monastic communities

nun-round2-new2.question: What does 'Ora et labora' commonly express?

answers.a1: Prayer and work
Distinctive clothing associated with some religious communities

nun-round2-new4.question: Do all Catholic women's religious communities wear identical clothing?

answers.a1: No; practices differ between communities
answers.a3: Only one community may wear a habit

nun-q5.question: The Benedictine tradition is closely associated with which foundational text?

answers.a1: The Rule of Saint Benedict

nun-q6.question: Which saint is most closely associated with founding the Poor Clares?

answers.a1: Saint Teresa of Calcutta

nun-round3-new1.question: Saint Teresa of Avila is especially associated with which tradition?

answers.a1: Carmelite

nun-round3-new2.question: Saint Francis of Assisi is especially associated with which family of religious traditions?

answers.a1: Franciscan

nun-round3-new3.question: What is the purpose of formation in religious life?

answers.a1: Preparation and ongoing growth in the community's way of life

nun-round3-new4.question: What does a community's charism help shape?

answers.a1: Its spiritual emphasis and mission

nun-q7.question: What are vows made for a defined period before perpetual profession commonly called?

answers.a1: Private intentions

nun-q8.question: Which description best fits a contemplative or cloistered community?

answers.a1: A community focused mainly on political office
answers.a2: A group that has no shared prayer
answers.a3: A community formed only for travel
answers.a4: A community focused strongly on prayer and a more enclosed way of life

nun-round4-new1.question: What does perpetual profession generally indicate?

answers.a1: A lifelong commitment through religious vows

nun-round4-new2.question: What is a retreat commonly intended to provide?

answers.a1: Time for prayer and reflection
answers.a4: A substitute for all daily responsibilities

nun-round4-new3.question: What is spiritual accompaniment or direction intended to support?

answers.a1: Reflection and growth in spiritual life
answers.a3: A guaranteed prediction of the future

nun-round4-new4.question: Why distinguish a vow from an informal personal preference?

answers.a1: A vow is a deliberate religious commitment
answers.a4: The two terms have no difference

nun-q9.question: In religious life, what does religious profession mean?

answers.a1: The public making of vows formally accepted by the Church
answers.a2: The selection of a secular career
answers.a4: The publication of a prayer book

nun-q10.question: Which description best fits an apostolic religious community?

answers.a1: A community with no common spiritual life
answers.a2: A community combining prayer with active service or ministry
answers.a3: A community devoted only to preserving buildings
answers.a4: A community that never works beyond its own members

nun-round5-new1.question: Which activity may be part of an apostolic community's ministry?

answers.a1: Education or care according to its mission
answers.a2: Only enclosed prayer in every case
answers.a4: A requirement to avoid all public service

nun-round5-new2.question: What does 'contemplative' emphasise in this context?

answers.a1: A life strongly centred on prayer and contemplation
answers.a2: An absence of all community responsibilities

nun-round5-new3.question: What should someone exploring a vocation do with questions about a community?

answers.a1: Discuss them with appropriate members or vocation guides
answers.a2: Assume every community is the same
answers.a3: Treat an online quiz as a vocation decision

nun-round5-new4.question: What can a general knowledge quiz about religious life establish?

answers.a1: What the participant answered in the quiz
answers.a4: The wishes of every religious community
